mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.tenant_id, t1.user_id, t1.role_id, t2.role_code, t2.role_name, t2.permission_type from sys_user_role_rel as t1 inner join sys_role as t2 on t1.role_id = t2.id and t1.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id and t2.del_flag = 0 where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.del_flag = 0 and t1.data_status = 1 and t2.data_status = 1
